mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain deeply suppressed, weekday trip chaining stays weak and retail footfall keeps leaking away, so RETAIL_REC stays lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 4-week mean while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain at least 5 points below their current 4-week averages for the full next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility stays elevated, people substitute home-based activity for shopping trips, which reduces discretionary retail visits within one to two weeks and pushes RETAIL_REC downward.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above +30 for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within the next 14 days after RESIDENTIAL stays above +30 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A further drop in TRANSIT below its already depressed level signals tighter movement restrictions, which suppresses access to retail corridors and lowers RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -85 and stays there for two weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower than its last-4-week mean after TRANSIT remains below -85 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM rises while RETAIL_REC remains near its floor, households are shifting spending toward essential trips rather than discretionary shopping, so retail activity keeps weakening over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM increases by at least 5 points week-on-week while RETAIL_REC stays below -85
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within 7 days despite GROCERY_PHARM increasing by at least 5 points and RETAIL_REC remaining below -85.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility indicates relaxed voluntary distancing and more outside-the-home activity, which spills into nearby retail visits and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week mean even after PARKS improves for three straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If all out-of-home categories stop deteriorating and stabilize at low levels, the sharpest mobility shock has passed and retail traffic should bottom out, making RETAIL_REC less negative over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and PARKS each vary by less than 2 points week-on-week for two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC keeps falling after WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and PARKS all stabilize within a 2-point weekly band for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT below already severe levels indicates renewed enforcement or capacity limits, which cuts incidental shopping trips and drives RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -75 and TRANSIT falls below -86 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not become more negative within 14 days after WORKPLACES drops below -75 and TRANSIT drops below -86 in the same week.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains elevated but GROCERY_PHARM eases, households have already stocked essentials and switch back to discretionary errands, so RETAIL_REC improves over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above +33 while GROCERY_PHARM falls below -50
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within 7 days after RESIDENTIAL stays above +33 and GROCERY_PHARM falls below -50.
